hooks.name: Validate Code Before Commit
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to verify code works before committing

action.prompt:
Before committing changes:
1. Verify the Flask server starts without errors
2. Test the demo mode at http://localhost:3000/?demo=1
3. Ensure no JavaScript errors in browser console
4. Check that AI insights display correctly (if API key is configured)
5. Confirm all modified files are staged
